summary.boundary: The packet is a manuscript organization and claim-control artifact. It preserves negative-validation and limitations boundaries and does not add new CFD results.

rows.paper_use: Use as workflow non-regression evidence for the CityLBM/FluidX3D chain.
rows.limitations: Smoke regression only; it is not benchmark accuracy validation.
rows.software_feedback: Keep Case A smoke as a required regression guard before stronger Case E claims.

rows.paper_use: Use as transparent negative validation of the current official z=2 m Case E result.
rows.limitations: Do not claim predictive accuracy, mesh independence, LES improvement, or formal v0.4.0 readiness.
rows.software_feedback: Accuracy-improvement work should target near-wall, wall-model, inlet turbulence, voxelization, and official probe protocol fidelity.

rows.paper_use: Use to explain which CityLBM settings are formal defaults and which are diagnostic switches.
rows.limitations: Default-policy evidence does not improve or replace the official z=2 m metric.
rows.software_feedback: Keep raw_trilinear official z=2 m as formal output; keep nuLBM, zOff and non-raw sampling diagnostic-only.

rows.metric_or_status: status=passed_reproduced_failed_metric; log_completed_48000=True; csv_sha256_equal=True; MAE=21.111408125 pp; R2=-2.006330362229977; Pearson=0.11575649438573923
rows.paper_use: Use as newly-run reproducibility evidence that the current compiled z-center Case E setup reproduces the same negative official z=2 m metric.
rows.limitations: This reinforces repeatability of the failure; it is not an accuracy improvement and cannot support formal v0.4.0.
rows.software_feedback: Prioritize physical wall/inlet/voxelization changes over more repeats of the same compiled baseline.

rows.paper_use: Use to document whether the next long official validation run is schedulable on this machine.
rows.limitations: Runtime readiness evidence only; no new solver output is produced.
rows.software_feedback: Keep Rhino new-GHA loading and native source compile evidence as operational gates before new formal Case E sweeps.

rows.paper_use: Use as a limitations/future-work statement for high-resolution official Case E follow-up planning.
rows.limitations: No dx=1 FluidX3D solver output was produced; do not claim mesh independence or improved official z=2 m accuracy.
rows.software_feedback: Keep dx=1 as a user-confirmed high-resolution follow-up path, not a default validation claim.

rows.paper_use: Use as a pre-registered follow-up sweep plan for improving the official z=2 m R2.
rows.limitations: Planning evidence only; it does not add solver output or justify changing CityLBM defaults.
